items.title: Covering sieves are exactly the sieves whose sheafification is an isomorphism

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes covering sieves by the property that the sheafification of the inclusion of the sieve into the representable presheaf is an isomorphism (statement lines 11902-11912). The proof is a complete equivalence: after recording that sheafification is two plus constructions and that the induced map is injective (proof lines 11914-11921), the author shows that for a covering sieve the identity of the sieve produces a section which yields the inverse (proof lines 11923-11932), and conversely that an isomorphism produces a covering sieve whose description is then used with the transitivity axiom to conclude that the sieve itself is covering (proof lines 11934-11948). The non-formal content is the construction of the inverse from the identity section. The claim is H2: two implications with each input named.
